word.name: relationship-type-allowed
word.title: Relationship Type Allowed
word.description: A relationship the owner or an admin adds or removes has a type the graph declares, and not one reserved for another operation or the nostr import.

graphRule.name: relationship-type-allowed
graphRule.says: a relationship the owner or an admin adds or removes has a type the graph declares, and not one reserved for another operation or the nostr import. A type is declared by being an element of the relationship type concept, `39998:<TA>:relationship-type`.
graphRule.kind: a graph rule, about the owner's and the admins' own writes (D4).
graphRule.check: the same `violations` over a set of relationships names each one that breaks it. `rules check` (A10.31) will run it over the graph, judging each relationship by where it came from (D15). A relationship an import recorded is a peer's claim, not one of the owner's writes.
graphRule.enforcedBy: the guards of `graph add-relationship` and `graph remove-relationship`. The rule's code is in `src/operations/rules/relationship-type-allowed.js`. Built in story graph-operations-foundation #4 (ADR 0004).

alsoSays.label: Reserved
alsoSays.text:
two groups.
- Every relationship type the active firmware declares. These are the class threads, a concept's core-node wiring, the property tree, and the import's `AUTHORS`, `HAS_TAG` and `REFERENCES`.
- What the instance's own code writes beyond them: `INHERITS_FROM`, `FOLLOWS`, `MUTES`, `REPORTS`, `TAGS`, `PROVIDED_THE_TEMPLATE_FOR`, `IMPORT`, `SUPERCEDES`, `SPECIFIC_INSTANCE`, `WOT_METRICS_CARDS` and `SERVES`.

A test fails if the code names a relationship type in Cypher that isn't reserved.

code.summary: A relationship the owner or an admin adds or removes has a type the graph declares, and not one reserved for another operation or the nostr import.

refusals.when: The relationship type is not one the graph declares as an element of its relationship type concept
The relationship type is reserved for another operation, or for the nostr import, which make it with the checks it needs
